notes.title: Update Version 1.3.0
notes.content:
Added new Language options: French, Spanish, German, and Portuguese!
 Added some multi-color combinations.
 Cleaned up some textures, and switched over to smaller file sizes

notes.title: Update Version 1.2.0
notes.content:
Update Version 1.2.0

 expanded on the first-launch Intro, slowed it down, and added another skip option
 very slight boost to ship speeds
 very slight boost to powerup spawn rates
 another battle mode map, Zones
 added blue asteroids: occasionally spawns. It spawns other asteroids and Ship Speed powerups.
 remove debug levels
 suppress command window
 add extra graphic for Warps

notes.title: Update Version 1.1.1
notes.content:
Hello All! Back with an update to PolyGone:

 Added new Battle Mode map - Castle
 Added 2 new Ships, Stubby and Shadow
 Added a new mechanic to Arcade Mode, PolyBot
 Added a new 30 second intro that plays on first launch to give a quick explainer


Have fun! pew pew pew!
